node.title: Exceptional-slope root charge for Hankel pencils
node.statement: For a moving generic apolar generator Q_Z of parameter degree e, a supported rank-drop slope of loss c retains domain roots while c is charged to Kronecker multiplicity. The base bound is T(rho-s)<=(N-s)e+rho-(R+1-2rho)e; contracting the fixed core strengthens the regular allowance to rho-s-(R+1-2rho+s)e. At the official A=3 profiles this closes every e<=2^37-1, forces the remaining high-degree branch to have no fixed domain roots, and also closes e=2^37 at the half-distance budget. At the A=1 endpoint it closes every e<=2^37 and leaves only three explicit core-size rows with s<=2.
